outline: This course covers insightful topics and advanced knowledge in foundation engineering, including site investigation, foundation design, bearing capacity, slope stability, and pile foundations. It also addresses soil improvement techniques, lateral earth pressure, and the use of geosynthetics in reinforced structures. Students will apply their knowledge through lectures and a term project.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Geotechnical Site Investigation, Special Topic (1)
Week 3: Geotechnical Site Investigation, Special Topic (2)
Week 4: Foundation Design, Shallow Foundations (1)
Week 5: Foundation Design, Shallow Foundations (2)
Week 6: Lateral Earth Pressure, Earth Retaining Structures, Special Topic
Week 7: Applications of Geosynthetics, GRS Wall Design (1)
Week 8: Applications of Geosynthetics, GRS Wall Design (2)
Week 9: Independent Study
Week 10: Ground Improvement, Soil Liquefaction (1)
Week 11: Ground Improvement, Soil Liquefaction (2)
Week 12: Slope Stability, Ground Anchors
Week 13: Pile Foundations
Week 14: Excavation
Week 15: Numerical Methods in Geotechnical Engineering
Week 16: Invited Lecture
Week 17: Term Project (1)
Week 18: Term Project (2)
